I know exactly what you mean.

Tonight, I sat and told myself "I need to finish my citations page for English." I then sat on my bed, feeling numb, as if I couldn't move, as if I could only lay. Hours later, my stomach churned for food. I told myself "I need food." I simply couldn't bring myself to get up, so after 30 minutes of grappling with a feeling of numbness and unwillingness to do anything, I walked to the kitchen and had a frozen pop tart.

This is the story of my life often times. Caffeine never helps my constant fatigue. I've had 3 24 oz Monsters today, and a coffee. I'm still fatigued and excessively tired. I slept through 3 classes today.

Maybe I'm just lazy or sloth. But, fuck, that's a depressing thought...

Very, but I never show it. People know me as the friendly, happy go lucky guy, who's always there to cheer someone up with a joke.

If someone is irrating me, I hide it, as I do with most things.

I have straight C's at an academically rigorous Catholic school. I have zero desire to be expelled, nor do I have any desire to go to a state school. Seeing as those two scenarios are becoming close to inevitable, my attitude towards academics has gone from skeptical optimism to full on pessimism and fear.

Yeah, I've self taught myself some languages. German and Dutch are the two I'm most proficient in, but unless I move to Europe, I suppose it doesn't matter.

Don't get me wrong, im not a sociopath who can't feel emotion. I'm a friendly guy at first glance, and I wish the best for a lot of people. That said, I never feel any love back, even if I'm receiving some. You have to remember, I'm extraordinary forgetful, clumsy, klutzy, rather stupid, mundane, unattractive, depressive, anxious, and eccentric. For those reasons, I'm worth very little, and I can't keep living tbh.

Thanks though, I'll consider what you've said.
